exposure: Cord blood lipid levels (HDL, LDL, triglycerides)
cohort: 60 trios of small-for-gestational-age (SGA), large-for-gestational-age (LGA), and optimal-for-gestational-age (OGA) infants from the Shanghai Birth Cohort
finding: Higher cord blood FABP4 concentrations were associated with a lower odds of SGA, but were not associated with LGA.
